logger = system.util.getLogger("myLogger")
	
	selectedLabel = event.label.title()
	self.custom.selectedItem = selectedLabel

	# Loop through all items in the props.items array
	for i in range(len(self.props.items)):
		self.refreshBinding("props.items[%d].style.classes" % i)
		
	
	
	if selectedLabel == 'Anita B. Smith':
		self.session.custom.panControl.scale = 1
		self.session.custom.panControl.x= 950
		self.session.custom.panControl.y = 550
		
	elif selectedLabel == 'Leland Thompson':
		self.session.custom.panControl.scale = 1
		self.session.custom.panControl.x= -970
		self.session.custom.panControl.y = 550

	elif selectedLabel == 'Booster Stations':

		self.session.custom.panControl.y = -480
		
	elif selectedLabel == 'Lift Stations':
		self.session.custom.panControl.scale = 1
		self.session.custom.panControl.x= -970
		self.session.custom.panControl.y = -480

# Loop through all items in the props.items array
	sibling = self.getSibling("HorizontalMenu")
	for i in range(len(sibling.props.items)):
		sibling.refreshBinding("props.items[%d].style.classes" % i)


	tagPath = "[default]Users/Users"
	value = list(system.tag.readBlocking(tagPath)[0].value)
	username = self.session.props.auth.user.userName
	
	# Process and update the list
	updated_value = []
	for item in value:
	    # Convert string to dictionary
	    data = eval(item)
	    
	    # Check for username and update theme
	    if data.get('username') == username:
	        data['theme'] = self.props.value
	    
	    # Convert back to string
	    updated_value.append(unicode(str(data)))
	
	# Output the updated list
	system.tag.writeBlocking(tagPath, [updated_value])
